question: Which departments have an average doctor salary greater than 200000, and what is their average doctor salary?
gold_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(doc.salary) FROM departments d JOIN doctors doc ON d.dept_id = doc.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name HAVING AVG(doc.salary) > 200000

question: List the full names of patients and their doctors for all completed appointments in the Cardiology department.
gold_sql: SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, doc.first_name, doc.last_name FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN doctors doc ON a.doctor_id = doc.doctor_id JOIN departments d ON doc.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE a.status = 'Completed' AND d.dept_name = 'Cardiology'

question: Find the names and specialties of doctors who have billed more than the average billing amount across all appointments.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT doc.first_name, doc.last_name, doc.specialty FROM doctors doc JOIN appointments a ON doc.doctor_id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.billing_amount > (SELECT AVG(billing_amount) FROM appointments)

question: What is the total billing amount generated by each doctor, ordered by total billing from highest to lowest?
gold_sql: SELECT doc.first_name, doc.last_name, SUM(a.billing_amount) AS total_billed FROM doctors doc JOIN appointments a ON doc.doctor_id = a.doctor_id GROUP BY doc.doctor_id, doc.first_name, doc.last_name ORDER BY total_billed DESC
